title: Penthouse June 2010 Alexis Texas Eva Angelina Complete w/ Centerfold
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Penthouse magazine, June 2010. Complete w/ Centerfold. Cover Girl: Alexis Texas. Pet: Eva Angelina.

Cover features: Artie Lange's near-death experience; Paul Provenza talks shop with Stephen Colbert and Judd Apatow; World Cup preview; Summer's sultriest stars.

Back cover: RAW rolling papers ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
